description: R08 DeserializationTests copy/inheritance seam: portable Rust owns deep-copy independence for Cascadia settings collections and clone-time reconstruction of the profiles.defaults inheritance graph.

entries.notes: CloneableCascadiaSettings deep-copies owned globals, profiles, color-scheme membership and the already-exact DeserializedActionMap; mutating WordDelimiters on the clone cannot alter the source aggregate.

Profiles retain local JSON and resolve inherited tabTitle/snapOnInput through the graph's current profiles.defaults node. Deep copy duplicates that node and reconnects copied profiles to it, preserving HasXxx independence and the one-parent optimization for empty/missing profiles.defaults.
